theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pushforward_integrality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → MapsTo f U V → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ T.support)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
